assets.name: Vikki · portrait Queen Bee S1
assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: ONE static 2D game dialogue portrait on a real transparent background.
Primary request: Draw VIKKI, the pink poodle hellhound on the LEFT of the supplied official Queen Bee episode frame. The wolf on the right is Loona and must NOT be included. This is a faithful character portrait, not a new character or costume.
Reference image role: primary visual reference for Vikki only. Preserve her pale cream face, long pointed canine muzzle and small dark nose, downturned half-lidded eyes with narrow pupils and long black lashes, pink eyelid accents, pink poodle coiffure with the very large rounded upper sweep, dark-rose hair shadow, curled side ear masses, distinctive pointed forehead lock, fluffy pale chest/neck fur, and crisp white blouse with pointed open lapels. Follow the exact left subject's face direction, proportions and dusty pink/cream/white palette. Use her skeptical aloof expression and three-quarter head turn toward viewer right from the frame.
Composition: a head-and-upper-chest portrait. Include the complete top and sides of the pink hair and ear curls with generous clear margin. End the portrait with a deliberate clean curved crop across the upper chest, below the blouse collar. Do not draw the waist, belt, skirt, legs or feet. Do not include the forearms or hands; this is a closely framed dialogue bust. No reconstruction of hidden lower body.
Style: polished hand-drawn animated-series cel illustration, precise dark tapered outlines, crisp flat shapes, restrained cel shading, readable at game dialogue scale. Match the reference design closely without adding patterns, accessories, horns or jewelry.
Background: transparent alpha, no room, no other figures, no floor, no shadow, no pin border, no text, no labels, no watermark. Exactly one portrait, not a sheet or multiple views.

sourceReferences.title: HELLUVA BOSS — QUEEN BEE, S1 Episode 8
sourceReferences.author: Vivziepop
sourceReferences.transform: Native 320×180 storyboard cell preserved byte-for-byte from V12. No enhancement or repainting.
sourceReferences.qualification: Vikki is the pink poodle at left. Complete hair, face, neck and blouse collar are qualified for the intentionally cropped upper-chest portrait only.

fidelityNotes: Portrait volontairement limité à la tête, au cou et au haut de la blouse ; la base entière de Vikki reste manquante.
Référence native de 320 × 180 px. Les contours fins du visage, les yeux, la fourrure et la coiffure sont redessinés ; aucune fidélité 1:1 certifiée.
Le dessin suit le museau vers la gauche de la référence. La mention vers la droite du prompt original était imprécise et n’est pas utilisée comme preuve de conformité.
Marges mesurées au seuil alpha 16 : haut 12 px, bas 2 px ; aucun pixel visible de la silhouette ne touche le bord. Le cadrage doit rester en contain dans la galerie.
Une seule pose statique narrative ; aucun kit, cycle animé, nouvelle identité ou base entière.
assets.intendedRole: Portrait narratif de réserve ; aucune base entière ni combattant ajouté.

independentReviewNotes.notes: Source 320 × 180 et marge basse de 2 px conservées comme limites explicites ; aucun nouveau compte de base entière.

assets.name: Tilla · portrait Nightmare — marchandise officielle
assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: ONE static 2D narrative archive portrait, isolated on a real transparent background.
Primary request: Adapt ONLY the TILLA character portrait from this official Nightmare Tilla pin illustration. Preserve the exact character drawing and the deliberate original bust boundary. The green flames, glitter and metallic pin frame are surrounding merchandise decoration and must be removed completely.
Reference image role: primary official merchandise illustration by Kain; preserve the specific Nightmare portrait rather than converting it into an episode model or full-body character.
Subject invariants: red imp face with angular jaw and pointed chin, yellow eyes with red irises and small dark pupils, long black upper lashes, the exact asymmetric damaged horns with black-and-pale stripes, large burgundy/purple swept hairstyle with its broad pale lavender highlight, long jagged hair framing the shoulders, smiling closed mouth, pointed violet collar, skull-shaped red brooch with black eyes at the neck, violet torn-edged sleeves, and the two red hands gently clasped together vertically at the chest. Follow the source hand pose and complete outlines of fingers, hair tips, horns and costume fragments. Match source colors, proportions and front-facing pose as closely as possible.
Composition: head, complete horns/hair, shoulders and the exact visible upper-torso/hand silhouette. End where the original portrait ends. Do not extend into legs, waist, feet, a full skirt or a standing pose. Keep generous transparent margin around every tip.
Style: clean hand-drawn animated-series cel art; crisp dark tapered outlines and flat colors with limited shading. Convert the shiny metallic separators to normal dark ink lines. No enamel reflection, no grain, no glitter, no bevel, no photographed object.
Background: transparent alpha. Exactly one character portrait; no green flames, no halo, no frame or ring, no floor, no shadow, no writing, no watermark, no other figure.
assets.correctionPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the edit target: the already corrected Tilla portrait. Image 2 is the official product photo. Image 3 is a native-resolution inspection crop of the tall horn in that same official photo.
Make exactly ONE small local change to Image 1. On the tall black horn at the viewer's RIGHT, replace ONLY the uppermost long white stripe near the blunt tip with the much smaller, short, partial, softly rounded white mark visible near the tip in Image 3. That source mark is an irregular rounded patch inside the black horn, not a broad stripe spanning its width. Match its small size and relative placement from the photo. Preserve black around this small mark. We are reproducing a mark visible in the official product photograph, without making a claim about episode canon.
Keep the two broader white stripes below it exactly as they are. Preserve the horn's entire existing outer contour, its height, tip, bend and black fill. Do not remove either lower stripe. Do not add a horn or an extension. Keep everything else in Image 1 unchanged: all face, eye and hair shapes, expression, colors, outline thickness, lavender hair highlight, skull brooch, clasped hands, purple clothing, complete bust silhouette, image framing and dimensions. Keep the existing real transparent background. No green flames, no metallic outline, no pin border, no shadow, no text, no extra objects. One isolated static portrait.

sourceReferences.title: Nightmare Tilla — Glitter Enamel Pin
sourceReferences.author: Kain
sourceReferences.transform: Original product PNG downloaded unchanged from its public product JSON image URL.
sourceReferences.qualification: The complete illustrated bust has identifiable face, hair, asymmetrical damaged horns, collar/brooch and clasped hands. Green glitter flames and metallic border are merchandise decoration, excluded from the adaptation.
sourceReferences.dateScope: Product publication/modification dates do not establish episode continuity; official_merchandise_undated.

fidelityNotes: Portrait Nightmare adapté d’une marchandise officielle illustrée par Kain. Ce dessin de produit ne certifie pas le modèle exact d’un épisode.
Continuité official_merchandise_undated. Le filtre season_2 est un plafond conservateur de divulgation, pas une attribution à un épisode ou une date canonique.
Flammes vertes à paillettes et bord métallique retirés par le générateur ; contours des cheveux, mains et vêtement réinterprétés en cel-shading, palette plus saturée que la photographie du pin.

Le premier essai ajoutait une petite corne au-dessus de la chevelure gauche et une extension bordeaux à la grande corne. Une correction native ciblée les a supprimées. Une seconde retouche native a réduit la marque blanche haute de la grande corne pour suivre la petite forme partielle photographiée sur le pin ; les deux essais précédents sont archivés hors livraisons.
Buste seulement, sans extension du bas du corps. Tilla reste un personnage d’archive décédé, jamais présenté comme ressuscité, recrutable ou jouable.
Marge basse de 19 px au seuil alpha 16, aucun contact avec le bord. Aucun nouveau kit, cycle animé, nouvelle identité ou base entière.

La marque blanche supérieure est reproduite d’après la photographie du produit officiel ; son statut de motif dessiné ou de reflet n’est pas établi. Elle ne constitue pas une affirmation de troisième bande dans le canon d’un épisode.
assets.intendedRole: Portrait narratif de réserve ; aucune base entière ni combattant ajouté.
assets.canonicalContext: Portrait Nightmare Tilla adapté du produit officiel Vivziepop / Shark Robot illustré par Kain. Ce modèle de marchandise ne constitue pas une feuille de modèle d’épisode ; son épisode exact n’est pas établi. Personnage décédé conservé exclusivement en archive narrative.
assets.spoilerScopeBasis: season_2 est uniquement le plafond conservateur du filtre de divulgation ; il ne date pas cette illustration de marchandise et ne l’attribue à aucun épisode précis.
